All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AtomicCounter
A thread-safe counter implementation using AtomicLong.
Counter
A shared counter, implemented with a different synchronization mechanism in each implementation.
CounterBenchmark
Benchmarks the Counter implementations.
CounterBenchmark.Trial
Outcome of one trial.
Main
Benchmark driver that compares four ways of incrementing a shared counter: no mutual exclusion, a mutex, an atomic, and a spin lock.
SpinLockCounter
A counter using a spin lock to achieve thread-safe operations.
Stats
Utility class providing basic statistical functions over a sample of measurements.
SynchronizedCounter
A counter implementation that uses synchronized methods to ensure mutual exclusion, making it thread-safe.
UnsafeCounter
A counter implementation that does not guarantee thread-safety.
UnsafeCounter uses a volatile long to store the counter value, but the increment() method is not thread-safe due to the lack of atomic operations.
